title: Truvian on Solana: signed decisions before money moves

lines.text: A payment on Solana, to Garantex. A sanctioned exchange. Truvian said no.
lines.say: A payment on Solana, to Garantex. A sanctioned exchange. Troovian said no.

lines.text: Agents move money on Solana in under a second. Nobody checks who is on the other side.
Truvian buys every fact from ranked miners on Telegraph. One cent each, with a receipt.
lines.say: Troovian buys every fact from ranked miners on Telegraph. One cent each, with a receipt.

lines.text: Then it checks the chain. A miner said 855. Solana said 998.
lines.say: Then it checks the chain. A miner said eight fifty-five. Solana said nine ninety-eight.

lines.text: Settlement assurance reads the mint on Solana, screens the counterparty, and answers: release, review, or reject.
Resolve settles prediction markets with three miners, then anchors the signed result on Solana.
And our own miner now answers Solana balances on Telegraph.
Signed decisions for Solana agents. truvian.xyz
lines.say: Signed decisions for Solana agents. Troovian dot x y z.
